children: American depositary receipts of BioNTech were higher after the company said gotistobart, a lung cancer treatment, nearly doubled median survival in a Phase 3 trial.
BioNTech ADRs were up 3.7% to $110.34 as of midday Monday. They have risen 5.4% year-to-date.

The biotechnology company on Monday said gotistobart, developed in collaboration with OncoC4, demonstrated a median overall survival of 18.5 months in patients with squamous non-small lung cancer whose disease had progressed in prior treatments. That compares with a median overall survival of 10 months for standard-of-care chemotherapy, the company said.

"The magnitude of the survival benefit observed with gotistobart as a chemotherapy-free treatment approach in the PRESERVE-003 clinical trial is highly encouraging," said the study's principal investigator, Rama Balaraman. "If confirmed in the pivotal portion of the Phase 3 trial, these findings could transform the standard of care in a setting where new therapies are urgently needed."
The data came from the first stage of the Phase 3 trial. The second stage is ongoing at upwards of 160 sites globally, BioNTech said.
